DECLARE @TidalJobNumber VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @FilePath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @EmailTo VARCHAR(8000)

SET @TidalJobNumber = ?
SET @FilePath =?
SET @EmailTo = ?

/*
SET  @TidalJobNumber = '77647185'
SET @FilePath =  '\\Va33dfs001.devad.wellpoint.com\Files\Shared\RegulatoryComplianceReporting\ManagedReports\Iowa\Data_Exchange\EXTRACTS\COVID_IMM\Outbound\'
*/

--look for jobfiles with empty tidaljobnumber and update
UPDATE JF SET 
 PathFileName =  REPLACE(PathFileName, '{&tidalJobNumber}', @TidalJobNumber)
FROM [EXTRACT].[RegistryJobFile] JF 
WHERE  (JF.TidalJobNumber IS NULL OR JF.TidalJobNumber = '')

UPDATE JF SET 
 PathFileName =   @FilePath + LEFT(JF.PathFileName,  LEN(JF.PathFileName) - CHARINDEX('\',REVERSE(JF.PathFileName),1) + 1),
 [PATH] =  @FilePath,
 TidalJobNumber =  @TidalJobNumber
FROM [EXTRACT].[RegistryJobFile] JF 
WHERE  (JF.TidalJobNumber IS NULL OR JF.TidalJobNumber = '')


SELECT
 JF.JobFileId,  [Path], PathFileName, @EmailTo
FROM [EXTRACT].[RegistryJobFile] JF
WHERE JF.TidalJobNumber =  @TidalJobNumber
ORDER BY JF.JobFileId
